title: "Exiting a window while no window is hovered should never happen in DisplayServer." warning on Wayland
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: master(755fa449c) 653fed37e  on wayland
- Not reproducible in: master(755fa449c) on xwayland, v4.7.dev2.official [778cf54da]

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (755fa449c) - Linux Mint 22.3 (Zena) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (RADV PHOENIX) - AMD Ryzen 7 8745H w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 25.22 GiB memory

### Issue description

When `run/platforms/linuxbsd/prefer_wayland` is enabled, moving the mouse while a hover popup is displayed may trigger the following warnings:

```
WARNING: Entering a window while a window is hovered should never happen in DisplayServer.
     at: _event_callback (scene/main/window.cpp:851)
```

```
WARNING: Exiting a window while no window is hovered should never happen in DisplayServer.
     at: _event_callback (scene/main/window.cpp:872)
```

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/416159e0-bf07-4b3d-b9ea-e0237865308c

Occasionally, the editor might crash. I'm not sure if it's related.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Enable the editor setting `run/platforms/linuxbsd/prefer_wayland` and restart the editor;
2. Hovering the mouse over certain controls causes tooltips to pop up;
3. Move the mouse to close the pop-up window when it appears;
4. Repeat steps 2–3 until a warning appears; this may require a bit of luck.
5. Occasionally, the editor might crash. I'm not sure if it's related.
